# bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/babel_minimize

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of the Open Babel tool.

Energetically minimizes small molecules. Open Babel is a chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data. It's an open, collaborative project allowing anyone to search, convert, analyze, or store data from molecular modeling, chemistry, solid-state materials, biochemistry, or related areas. Visit the official page.

Nextflow adapter of the [BabelMinimize](https://biobb-chemistry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/babelm.html#module-babelm.babel_minimize) building block of [biobb_chemistry](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_BABEL_MINIMIZE } from 'bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/babel_minimize'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_BABEL_MINIMIZE(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_path` | yes | pdb, mol2 | Path to the input file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | yes | pdb, mol2 | Path to the output file |
| `versions_biobb_chemistry` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_chemistry', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of BabelMinimize properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_chemistry container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_BABEL_MINIMIZE' {
        ext.properties = [method: 'cg']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `criteria` | number | 1e-06 | Convergence criteria |
| `method` | string | "cg" | Method. Values: cg, sd. |
| `force_field` | string | null | Force field. Values: GAFF, Ghemical, MMFF94, MMFF94s, UFF. |
| `hydrogens` | boolean | false | Add hydrogen atoms. |
| `steps` | integer | 2500 | Maximum number of steps. |
| `cutoff` | boolean | false | Use cut-off. |
| `rvdw` | number | 6.0 | VDW cut-off distance. |
| `rele` | number | 10.0 | Electrostatic cut-off distance. |
| `frequency` | integer | 10 | Frequency to update the non-bonded pairs. |
| `binary_path` | string | "obminimize" | Path to the obminimize executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
